findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With user_count=100 and limit=50 it returns 3, but there are only 2 pages. showingLast (currentPage == totalPages) then never becomes true on the real last page. Pressing next there sets offset to min(offset+limit, user_count) = user_count, which requests an empty out-of-range page. Use Math.ceil(user_count / limit) instead.

findings.title: limit and offset from params are not validated
findings.body: limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i and offset = params[:offset].to_i are used directly. A negative offset is passed to SQL OFFSET and causes a database error (500). A very large or negative limit is also accepted without a cap, so a single request can dump an entire large group's membership. Clamp limit to a sane maximum (e.g. 1..200) and clamp offset to >= 0.

findings.title: members endpoint now runs a COUNT on every page request
findings.body: Each request runs group.users.count plus the paginated query. Combined with the unbounded limit above, this makes large groups expensive to page through on every click. The removed code paginated only automatic groups, so non-automatic groups are now paginated too, which changes behaviour for all callers.

findings.title: Admin group create/update request contract changed without compatibility
findings.body: The controller now reads top-level params (params[:name], params[:usernames] is gone) instead of params[:group][...]. PUT /admin/groups/:id no longer accepts usernames, and PATCH with changes[:add]/[:delete] was removed. Any external API client or script using the previous nested format will silently break. This is not called out in the PR description.

findings.title: update does not strip the group name, unlike create
findings.body: create does (params[:name] || '').strip, but update assigns group.name = params[:name] unchanged. Names with surrounding whitespace can be saved through edit but not through creation, so the two paths disagree on validity.

findings.title: add_members does not trim usernames and silently ignores unknown ones
findings.body: usernames.split(",") keeps whitespace, so 'alice, bob' looks up ' bob' and silently skips it. Unknown usernames are dropped with no error returned to the UI, so the admin sees success with no member added.

findings.title: Coverage for updating non-automatic groups was removed and not replaced
findings.body: The old '.update' tests covering membership changes and name/visibility updates on regular groups were deleted. The new update spec only covers the automatic-group rename case. Nothing tests alias_level or visible changes on a normal group, and the pagination added to GroupsController#members has no spec.

findings.title: Stale selector for the old group-users element
findings.body: The rule 'input#group-users' under .row.groups targets an element id that the template no longer renders (the user-selector now uses id="user-selector"). The rule is dead code and misleads future maintainers.
